sloka: इमां हि रम्यां मृगयूथशालिनीं निपीततोयां गजसिंहवानरै: ।सुपुष्पितै: पुष्पधरैरलङ्कृतां न सो ऽस्ति य: स्यादगतक्लम: सुखी ॥ २.९५.१८॥
transliteration: imāṁ hi ramyāṁ mṛgayūthaśālinīṁ nipītatoyāṁ gajasiṁhavānarai: ।supuṣpitai: puṣpadharairalaṅkṛtāṁ na so 'sti ya: syādagataklama: sukhī ॥ 2.95.18॥

translations.english: With this enchanting Mandakini teeming with herds of deer, whose waters are drunk by elephants, lions and monkeys, decorated with heaps of flowers fallen from the trees in full bloom, who will not feel happy and free from fatigue.
